units: <cite ref="Chullin 17b:1">Ḥull. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>ושאין בה אלא פ׳ אחת</he> but a knife which has only one notch (v. <cite ref="A00337"><he>אָגַר</he> II</cite>); <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 1:7">Tosef. ib. I, 7</cite>. Ḥull. l. c. <he>פְּגִימַת עצם בפסח</he> a cut in the bone of a Passover lamb (forbidden in <cite ref="Exodus 12:46">Ex. XII, 46</cite>); <he>פ׳ אוזן בבכור</he> a cut in the ear of a first-born animal (by which it is rendered unfit as a sacrifice, and may be eaten by the priest outside of the seat of the sanctuary); <he>פ׳ מום בקדשים</he> the blemish, created by a cut, of a consecrated (female) sacrifice; <he>וכולן פְּגִימָתָן כדי פ׳ המזבח</he> and all of these incisions are measured by the standard of an indentation in the altar; ib. 18ᵃ <he>וכמה פ׳ המזבח</he> and how large is the indentation which unfits the altar?; v. <cite ref="H00158"><he>חָגַר</he> II</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּגִימוֹת</he>. Ib. 17ᵇ; a. fr.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 23b:13">R. Hash. 23ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>לפני החמה</he> <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:6">ib. II, 6</cite>) <he>פְּגִימָתָהּ לפני החמה וכ׳</he> was the concave side of the crescent directed towards the sun or away from the sun? <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מעולם … פגימתה של לבנה ולא פגימתה של קשת</he> the sun never faces the concave of the crescent or the concave of a rainbow; Y. ib. II, 58ᵃ <he>פִּיגְמָתָהּ</he>; a. e.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 73b:9">Snh. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>במקפדת על פגימתה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="Q00585"><he>פִּיגְמָהּ</he></cite>) when she is excited over her violation, and says &c.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:2:10">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵃ</cite> bot. <cite ref="Q00060"><he>פגימה</he></cite>, read: <he>פְּגוּמָה</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00074"><he>פָּגַם</he></cite>.]
